title: Concept: Gemfile installs a gem from a git remote
description: Gemfile declares a gem sourced from a git remote rather than rubygems.org, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The code is outside the gem checksum and yank controls, so the lockfile's integrity model does not describe it.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Gemfile (rubygems).
risk: The code is outside the gem checksum and yank controls, so the lockfile's integrity model does not describe it.
